intent: The inspector's fill/color row: a color swatch trigger, an editable hex field, and an opacity field. Supports solid / gradient / image / variable fill types and keyframes.
use_when: Editing a fill or color in the inspector (a Fill / Stroke / Effect row).
You need hex + opacity entry alongside a swatch that opens the picker.

tokens.note: Composite (in Input.tsx). The swatch shows the live fill; the default color prop is a hardcoded #ff24bd placeholder — so not tokensOnly.

a11y.role: a composite: a swatch button (onSwatchClick), a hex textbox, and an opacity spinbutton — each with its own aria-label.
a11y.hex: accepts a 6-digit hex; invalid entry reverts.

code.example:
<ColorInput ariaLabel="Fill" color={fill} opacity={opacity}
  onSwatchClick={openPicker} onColorChange={setFill} onOpacityChange={setOpacity} />
